author: Diabolicx
body: So with the new atlas update maps on here will have xml files instead of yml. I like to write xml files, and I think it would be nice if you could release some sort of guide on how to write those. I am familiar with xml for overcast maps, but i'm not sure if xml files for avicus will be the same (my question is: is the xml going to be the same for overcast and avicus?)

title: Small question about xml/yml

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
The avicus xml is different from the ocn xml but a guide can be found here: https://atlas.avicus.net/en/
It can be found under modules but feel free to explore.
